records.title: Microfilm scanner station
records.summary: The one microfilm scanner in the basement, with its motorised reel transport and its lamp. It scans one reel at a time.

data.context: Nothing else in the project can start until a reel has been scanned. The Courier exists only on 212 microfilm reels, and a reel cannot be searched. This station turns each reel into page images at 400 dpi greyscale. If it scans badly, every later step reads a bad page. If its transport slips, it can scratch a master reel, and there is no second copy of the film.
data.summary: 63 of the 212 reels are scanned, 9,512 pages in all. A reel takes 2 h 35 min on average, timed on 9 reels. Older film is more curled and has to run slower, so the 1880s reels take the longest. The take-up spool slipped in week one and skipped 31 frames on R-1923-04; a new tension spring is being fitted. 37 pages of R-1923-02 were scanned twice by mistake, and the copies are marked. Two nitrate reels were found this morning in the 1931 crate, on the shelf beside the lamp. Nothing more from that crate is scanned until they are moved.

records.title: First reel through the scanner
records.summary: R-1923-01 went through the scanner today and took just under three hours, threading included.

data.body:
Reel R-1923-01 went through the scanner this afternoon. It is the first reel of the run.

It took just under three hours from start to finish. About twenty minutes of that was threading the film onto the take-up spool, which will get quicker with practice.

The frames came out sharp at 400 dpi greyscale. The lamp gets hot after an hour, so I left the room door open.

Tomorrow the agents draw up the steps from reel to searchable page.

records.title: 周二校对
records.summary: 第一次周二校对，来了九位志愿者。

data.body:
今天是第一次周二校对，来了九位志愿者。

每人先拿一卷的页面，两个人对一卷。大家都说报纸上的小字比想的难认。

下次要提前把批次单打印好。

records.title: Reel census: 212 reels on the shelf list, six with damage noted
records.summary: All 212 reels on the shelf list are in the cold store; six have damage written on the box.

data.body:
We checked every reel against the shelf list. All 212 are there, covering 1884 to 1961.

Six reels have damage noted. Four have torn leaders. Two smell of vinegar, which means vinegar syndrome.

The census also found that 37 pages of R-1923-02 were scanned twice by mistake. They will be removed before OCR.

records.title: Call with the heritage fund's grants officer
records.summary: The grants officer wants measured OCR accuracy in the interim report, not an estimate.

data.body:
Spoke to the heritage fund's grants officer about the interim report due on 26 September.

The officer wants the word accuracy measured on real pages, not an estimate. The fund's target is 90 %.

I said the 300-page sample is drawn and the volunteers are proofreading it. The officer would rather have the report a little late with a measured table than on time with a guess.

records.title: 冷库温度又到了 20 度
records.summary: 冷库又到了 20 度，离 21 度的 alert 只差一度。

data.body:
早上看冷库温度计，又到了 20 度。目标是 18 度，21 度报警。

门口的密封条有点松，下午先用胶带贴上了。climate-log 每小时记一次，明天再看曲线。

records.title: Induction for four new volunteers
records.summary: Four new volunteers learned the proofreading routine, which brings the team to fourteen.

data.body:
Four new volunteers came for their induction this Saturday morning. That brings the team to fourteen.

We covered how to handle a page image, how to mark a word they cannot read, and when to ask at the reference desk. Each of them proofread ten pages with an experienced volunteer.

records.title: 1923 年那一段确实缺了
records.summary: 1923 年有 12 期报纸不在任何一卷胶片上。

data.body:
把 1923 年的期号一期一期对过了，确实有 12 期不在任何一卷上。

之前说 R-1923-01 有全年的每一期，这个说法要撤回。缺的期号列了一张单子，下周问县档案馆有没有纸本。

records.title: Visit to the conservation studio
records.summary: The studio has the six damaged reels, but its splicer is broken.

data.body:
Took the six damaged reels to the conservation studio.

The studio's splicer is broken. The four reels with torn leaders can be mended by hand. The two with vinegar syndrome need the splicer and must wait.

The studio will tell us when a new blade arrives.

records.title: Library board meeting: the archive item
records.summary: The board took the progress note a day early and asked when the public search site will open.

data.body:
The archive item came near the end of the board meeting. The monthly progress note went in today, a day before it was due, and the board minuted it.

The board asked when the public search site will open. I said the final report is due on 31 March 2027 and the site will be up before then.

One member asked about the £18,500 grant. Spending is on track against the grant lines.

records.title: What rented GPU time would cost, written down once
records.summary: A one-reel trial on rented GPU time would cost about 40 US dollars, paid from the library's card.

data.body:
Binarisation alone costs 1.8 s a page on the library's one computer. With OCR on top, the bulk run would take that computer for weeks.

Rented GPU time is billed by the hour. A one-reel trial would cost about 40 US dollars. It is paid on the library's card, and this month's card limit is spent until the 28th.

Nothing is decided. The trial will tell us whether the bulk run is worth renting for.

records.title: What the interim report is actually waiting on
records.summary: The interim report waits only on the accuracy table, which waits on the volunteers' proofread sample.

data.body:
The interim report was due today and has not gone.

The progress section and the spending section are written. The only missing part is the accuracy table.

The accuracy table needs the 300-page sample proofread by hand, so both OCR runs can be scored against it. The volunteers are still proofreading the sample. Nothing else is holding the report.

records.title: 周六校对，人来得比平时多
records.summary: 这周六来校对的人比平时多，样本页推进得快。

data.body:
今天周六校对，人来得比平时多，十四位志愿者来了十二位。

大部分时间都在做那 300 页的样本。平均每小时 41 页，和以前差不多。

records.title: The 1890s masthead puts the date under the title
records.summary: In the 1890s the Courier printed the date under the title, not beside it, so the date reader misses it.

data.body:
Looked at the 1890s pages the date reader got wrong. In those years the masthead prints the date in a line under the title, not beside it.

The reader looks for the date in the wrong place, so it reads the volume number or nothing at all.

records.title: First feedback on the search preview from the reference desk
records.summary: The reference desk found the preview search useful but wants results sorted by date.

data.body:
The reference desk tried the search preview for an hour.

They found it quick and useful. They want results sorted by date, and they want the page image next to the text. Two searches for street names found nothing because the places index is not loaded yet.

records.title: 什么算广告，什么算启事
records.summary: 分割器把 6 % 的广告当成了文章，要先写清楚广告和启事的区别。

data.body:
版面分割器把 6 % 的广告当成了文章。问题在于广告和启事长得很像。

暂定：卖东西、报价钱的是广告；寻人、失物、开会通知是启事。

600 个框要重新标，等定义写完再动。

records.title: Second copy now at the branch library
records.summary: The scans made so far now have a second copy on the drive at the branch library.

data.body:
The second drive is now at the branch library with a copy of the scans made so far.

The drive cut file names at 64 characters. The page files were renamed to a shorter pattern before copying. The copy lives under /srv/courier-archive/scans/ on that drive.

records.title: 校对指南草稿要点
records.summary: 校对指南的几个要点：看不清就标出来，不要猜。

data.body:
校对指南草稿的要点：

一、看不清的字用方括号标出来，不要猜。
二、原文的拼写错误照抄，不要改。
三、广告和启事分开标。
四、有疑问就问参考咨询台。

records.title: Week three, in one paragraph
records.summary: Week three: the full sample said 81 % for the 1880s and the interim report went past its deadline.

data.body: The full 300-page sample said the new binarisation reads the 1880s at 81 %, not the 88 % the early 40-page try showed. The interim report passed its 26 September deadline with the accuracy table empty. The 1950s keep the old binarisation. The advert definition is still being written. The spare scanner finished the 1930 reels. 63 reels and 9,512 pages are scanned so far.

records.summary: 潮汐表的排版大约每十年变一次，读成数字要分年代处理。

data.body:
翻了几个年代的潮汐表，排版大约每十年换一次。

早期是一段文字，后来变成两栏，再后来变成表格。要读成数字，得按年代分开写规则。

records.title: Which confidence threshold should send a page to the volunteers?
records.summary: The proofreading queue is waiting for you to choose the OCR confidence threshold.

data.body:
I have stopped filling the proofreading queue until you choose the threshold.

At 85 % OCR confidence the queue holds 2,304 pages. A higher threshold sends more pages to the volunteers. A lower one lets more errors reach the site.

The task is "Choose the confidence threshold for sending pages to proofreading".

records.title: The full sample says 81 %, not 88 %, for the 1880s pages
records.summary: On the full sample the new binarisation reads the 1880s at 81 %, not 88 %.

data.body:
The full 300-page sample puts the 1880s pages at 81 % word accuracy with the new binarisation.

The early try said 88 %, but it used 40 pages picked from the clearest reels. Both claims are on file. I have not decided between them; that is yours.

records.title: Which of the two 1890s date failures should I fix first?
records.summary: The date reader fails on the 1890s in two ways; which one first?

data.body:
The date reader fails on the 1890s pages in two ways.

First, the date sits under the title, and the reader reads the volume number instead. Second, on worn pages it reads nothing at all.

Fixing the first is quicker. Fixing the second recovers more issues. Which should I do first?

740 places are left after the county gazetteer. Spread at 250 a day, they take three days, or a week at a gentler pace. I have stopped until you choose.

63 reels scanned. 9,512 pages scanned. 1,214 issues read.

Spending is listed against each grant line of the £18,500. The accuracy table is still empty: it waits on the proofread sample.
